The '''Roldalna cantina''' was used as a meeting place by the [[Buzchub]] [[Und'l]]. He contacted some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to transport some [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from [[Nigel VI]] to [[Lohopa II]]. The [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] has a [[photon dart board]] and a [[Zero-G dance floor|Zero G dance floor]].
